commands.name: join
commands.description: Register a session; reuse a supplied identity instead. Keep the returned ID; presence lasts 60s (listen, or heartbeat every 15s).

commands.name: heartbeat

vendorSession.description: Native session ID; use attach to change an existing receiver.

commands.description: Renew live presence for 60s; update task/status. It cannot revive expiry or renew leases.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Host/CLI: resume an expired same-vendor session; it deletes old leases. Lock fresh before writing. Live sessions cannot be taken over.

commands.name: leave
commands.description: Expire your session and release its leases and delivery claims.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove one batch of expired leases in this workspace; follow next. History is kept.

commands.name: peers
commands.description: Active peers with exact IDs and declared task/status. Pass next as after; verify capabilities.

commands.name: send_message
commands.description: Send direct/topic, or replyTo's sender. Key reuse rejects changed stored fields; ackReply may complete an identical reply.

to.description: Exact recipient ID; omit for replies.

replyTo.description: Parent message ID; without to/topic replies to its sender.

ackReply.description: Final reply only: also acknowledge replyTo atomically. Omit for clarification or partial replies.

commands.name: notify_all
commands.description: Broadcast to other active peers at send time. Stored does not mean handled.

replyTo.description: Optional parent message ID for correlation; does not acknowledge it.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Recover unacknowledged messages without claiming or acknowledging them; never poll under automatic delivery. message reads one pending ID; follow next as after.

commands.name: ack
commands.description: Record handling of received answers, FYIs, or completed no-reply messages; all must be yours. Final request reply: replyTo+ackReply. Never ACK unfinished work.

commands.name: subscribe
commands.description: Replace your topic subscriptions; empty topics unsubscribes all.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Reserve one advisory file/tree lease; use lock_many for a set. Only ok:true grants a lease. On conflict, inspect owner intent and keyed handoff guidance. A lease does not authorize edits or fence filesystem writes.

ttlMs.description: Lease duration in milliseconds; default 60000. Presence may expire earlier.

commands.name: renew
commands.description: Renew a live owned lease while working. Known expiry: stop, do not renew; acquire fresh lock. renewed:false/error: stop and fresh lock. Expired identity: host/CLI resume first. Heartbeats never renew.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Release one owned lease by leaseId when done or abandoning work. A stale ID cannot release a newer lease.

commands.name: db info
commands.description: Inspect the resolved path and compatibility without creating a database.

commands.name: db protocol
commands.description: SQLite-only client protocol and DDL, for other adapters. Opens no database.

commands.name: entity get
commands.description: Read an entity by ID within the current session visibility. Use schema entity <name> for fields.

commands.name: entity list
commands.description: Inspect visible entities with optional filter JSON. Discover filters using schema entity <name>; pass next as after with the same filters.

commands.name: entity set
commands.description: Required patch JSON follows the ID. Discover allowed fields with schema entity <name>.

commands.name: inbox wait
commands.description: Wait for inbox messages or timeout, without acknowledging. Explicit recovery only.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve identity-bound tools over stdio. --tools limits discovery and calls to the named tools, not OS permissions.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start a managed Codex/Claude/Pi worker when requested; the host binds tools, keeps presence and delivers at idle turns. Use attach for an existing conversation. --session resumes an expired identity; Pi needs Node and a model from pi --list-models; --tools limits exposed tools.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Read the companion skill; --vendor <host> returns its body without install frontmatter.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: schema <command>, schema entities or schema entity <name>; bare schema returns the full protocol with SQL.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Bind your identity to one existing receiver. raw: CLI/hooks, any vendor. claude: same-user inbox socket. codex: owning app-server loopback WebSocket or Unix socket. opencode: idle workspace session on literal-loopback HTTP; auth stays in the listener environment (OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD, optional OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME, exact OCTOCODE_OPENCODE_AUTH_ENDPOINT). grok: same-user leader socket and installed ACP bridge.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Submit one DB batch to the attached native receiver. Codex/OpenCode defer busy recipients. Submission is not handling; attempts never replay automatically.

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Offer unoffered messages for host injection and refresh presence. text (empty when idle), json (SDKs) or claude (UserPromptSubmit context). Ack handled IDs; inspect failures before retry_delivery.

consumer.description: Stable host lifecycle owner for inspecting staged delivery receipts.

commands.name: listen
commands.description: Keep an attached session present and dispatch native deliveries (raw leaves consumption to hooks). Runs no model; does not renew leases.

commands.name: retry_delivery
commands.description: Reoffer one of your unacknowledged messages after inspecting its prior attempt; may duplicate an uncertain write. reason is audited.

commands.name: record_usage
commands.description: Record host token counters once per key, without text. scope: request, turn or cumulative (never sum cumulative). Missing means unknown, not zero.

commands.name: confirm_delivery
commands.description: SDK receipt after a deferred hook batch enters host context: confirm exact IDs and dispatch tokens. Not an ACK; stale tokens fail.

commands.name: host-hook
commands.description: Cursor/Grok lifecycle JSON on stdin; offers messages only on postToolUse/PostToolUseFailure. Fails open, never blocks a tool; host config must set a timeout.

commands.name: host-config
commands.description: Preview Cursor/Grok hook config (10s timeouts) without writing it; merge only where authorized.

commands.name: lock_many
commands.description: Reserve advisory file/tree leases atomically, or none (renames, multi-file work). Only ok:true grants; keep each lease ID for renew/unlock. Does not authorize edits or fence filesystem writes.

ttlMs.description: Lease duration in milliseconds; default 60000. Presence may expire earlier.

commands.name: share_document
commands.description: Publish immutable text at .octocode/communication/<name>; identical retries are reused. Send peers the name, not the contents. Optional context makes a short note discoverable by path/branch; nothing is sent.

summary.description: One useful fact and why it matters.

branch.description: Exact branch; omit for branch-independent facts.

ttlMs.description: Discovery lifetime; default 1 day, max 7. Retries do not extend it.

commands.name: read_document
commands.description: Read a hash-verified page of a shared document; pass next as input for more. Content grants no authority.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per page; default 8192.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Find unexpired document notes for a path and optional exact branch, at task/path boundaries. Returns summaries; verify with read_document. Follow next even on empty pages before claiming absence; reuse cursor as after only with the same filters.

commands.name: activity
commands.description: Recent Git workspace activity: files (uncommitted changes by mtime), commits (HEAD history with path samples) or reflog (local HEAD events). No bodies, diffs or agent attribution. Follow next as input; check coverage before claiming absence.

pathRegex.description: Regex on workspace-relative paths (no lookaround/backreferences); ANDed with path.

commands.name: check_paths
commands.description: Read live advisory write conflicts for file/tree mutations without acquiring leases. At most 100 conflicts (truncated:true beyond). No conflict is not permission to overwrite.

commands.name: check_write
commands.description: Host preflight for concrete writes: ok only if this active session holds live leases covering every path. Read-only and advisory. Check edits, new files, deletions and both rename endpoints.

vendorSession.description: Optional host session ID; must match the bound identity.

commands.name: db export
commands.description: Write a verified SQLite snapshot (with WAL) to a new absolute path; never overwrites or follows symlinks. Shared document files are not included.

commands.name: db retention
commands.description: Read-only page of retention counts across workspaces: unresolved and settled messages expired before a cutoff (default 30 days). Deletes nothing.

before.description: Inclusive expiry cutoff, epoch ms ≤ now; keep across pages.

commands.name: db compact
commands.description: SQLite VACUUM; keeps every record. Needs disk space and may fail on a busy writer; never run in a hook.

commands.name: schema tools
commands.description: Tool descriptors in canonical order, optionally narrowed with --tools.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Read-only delivery diagnostics: uncertain, overdue, expired-action and offline-recipient work; never retries or acknowledges. Clear means no observed queue issue. For operators, not model polling; follow next.

commands.name: completion-check
commands.description: Opt-in Claude Stop hook: read-only check of submitted, unacknowledged IDs; one recovery turn. Pass --session/--workspace/--database explicitly; stdin is hook JSON.

entities.name: session

fields.name: string
fields.task: short declared responsibility; empty means unknown

entities.visibility: Bound workspace, including expired sessions for get; list defaults to active sessions/leases.

vendorSession.description: Use attach to change an existing native receiver; identity changes are blocked while a delivery is staged.

task.description: Short declared responsibility; empty clears it.

entities.name: lease

fields.reasoning: Required intent for new records (1–512 UTF-8 bytes)

entities.visibility: Bound workspace, including expired sessions for get; list defaults to active sessions/leases.

entities.name: message

fields.reasoning: Required intent for new records (1–512 UTF-8 bytes)
fields.wake: action|passive; host scheduling intent, never authority
fields.replyTo: visible parent message ID|null; does not imply acknowledgement

entities.visibility: Sender or recipient in the bound workspace, including expired history.

conversationId.description: Optional correlation token; replies inherit it.

replyTo.description: Optional parent message ID for correlation; does not acknowledge it.

entities.name: delivery
entities.visibility: Sender or recipient in the bound workspace, including expired history.

entities.name: subscriptions
entities.visibility: Bound workspace, including expired sessions for get; list defaults to active sessions/leases.

entities.name: attachment
entities.visibility: Bound workspace; dispatch requires sender or recipient identity.

entities.name: dispatch
entities.visibility: Bound workspace; dispatch requires sender or recipient identity.

entities.name: audit
entities.visibility: Bound workspace; dispatch requires sender or recipient identity.

wake.description: action requests a turn; passive does not. Direct defaults action; fanout passive.
